ai_analysis.summary: Good match for a junior Python/backend profile. The role centers on Python, backend work, REST APIs, and FastAPI, which align well with the candidate’s current stack. Remote is possible, though the listing is based in Madrid and marked onsite, so location flexibility may matter.
strengths: Strong overlap on Python and backend development
FastAPI and REST APIs match directly
Remote work is mentioned as possible
Role is not obviously too senior for a junior backend candidate
gaps: No explicit PostgreSQL mention in the job
Pandas is listed but not in the candidate CV
AWS and Google Cloud are only advantages, not required, but could help
Listing says onsite in Madrid, which may conflict with the candidate’s remote preference
ai_analysis.role_description: Python Software Engineer focused on backend development, REST APIs, FastAPI, and Pandas, with AWS/Google Cloud as advantages. Remote work may be possible for the right candidate.
ai_analysis.application_advice: Apply if the candidate is comfortable with a potentially onsite role in Madrid or can negotiate remote. Emphasize FastAPI, REST API work, backend projects, and any SQL/Docker experience. If they have any exposure to Pandas or cloud basics, mention it clearly.
